description: The Sankey that keeps its shape. Colors, order and positions belong to the node name, so a slicer or a refresh never repaints or reshuffles the chart. Bind the data you already have: Source and Destination pairs at any depth, or a flat table with one column per stage. No reshaping, no helper tables, no DAX. Free features (no watermark, never blocked): Pairs at any depth or a flat table with up to three stage columns, up to 40 nodes; the visual builds the columns itself Blank stages skipped, shown as (Blank) so you see where paths stop, or ending the path Loops drawn as arcs (rework, recovery, returns), never as duplicated nodes Correct numbers: zero flows are never drawn as 1, negative values are never silently made positive, and a status line says what was hidden and why Stable colors per node name with a real-name color picker for every node, plus conditional formatting (fx) on node and link colors Node icons from a built-in set and a note under any node, picked by node name Gradient, source, target or single link colors, arrowheads, curvature, opacity Value and percentage labels (of total, of column, of source) that honour the model's format string and display units; labels that do not fit hide instead of overlapping Hover and click to trace a node's whole path, cross-filtering, highlight from other visuals, bookmarks, tooltips and report page tooltips Sort by fewest…
